접다.ex: 먼저 이 종이를 반으로 한 번 접으세요.
접다.x: First, fold this paper in half once.

경우.x: In case of rain, the event will be canceled.
경우.t: Pattern -(으)ㄴ/는 경우(에) means 'in case, when': 아픈 경우에 연락하세요.

목표.ex: 올해 제 목표는 토픽 3급을 따는 거예요.
목표.x: My goal this year is to get TOPIK Level 3.
목표.e: Literally 'eye mark' — the target your eye aims at.
목표.t: Set a goal with 세우다 (목표를 세우다) and reach it with 이루다.

뿌듯하다.x: I feel really proud that I finished a difficult task.
뿌듯하다.e: Originally 'full to bursting': picture your chest swelling with satisfaction.
뿌듯하다.t: Pronounced [뿌드타다]: the final ㅅ (sounding ㄷ) plus ㅎ becomes ㅌ.

개인적.ex: 개인적으로 저는 이 영화가 더 좋아요.
개인적.x: Personally, I like this movie better.
개인적.e: -적 turns a noun into '-al/-ic': 개인적, 사회적, 경제적.
개인적.t: Mostly used as 개인적으로 'personally' or 개인적인 + noun 'personal ...'.

헬스장.x: I go to the gym after work.
헬스장.e: From English 'health' plus -장 (place); in Konglish 'health' means working out.
헬스장.t: 체육관 is a sports gymnasium; for a weight-training gym, Koreans say 헬스장.

느긋하다.ex: 제 남편은 성격이 느긋해서 화를 잘 안 내요.
느긋하다.x: My husband is easygoing, so he rarely gets angry.
느긋하다.e: Think of it as the opposite of 급하다 'impatient, in a hurry'.
느긋하다.t: Pronounced [느그타다]: the ㅅ sounds like ㄷ and merges with ㅎ into ㅌ.

식은땀.ex: 발표 전에 너무 긴장해서 식은땀이 났어요.
식은땀.x: I was so nervous before the presentation that I broke out in a cold sweat.
식은땀.e: 식은 'cooled' (from 식다) + 땀 'sweat' = a cold sweat.

동원하다.m: to mobilize, to bring in, to use all available (people or means)
동원하다.x: Helicopters and soldiers were mobilized for the rescue.
동원하다.t: Also figurative: 모든 방법을 동원하다 'use every possible means'.

작심삼일.m: resolutions that don't last; giving up after three days
작심삼일.ex: 새해 다이어트 계획이 또 작심삼일로 끝났어요.
작심삼일.x: My New Year's diet plan fizzled out after a few days again.
작심삼일.e: Literally 'a made-up mind lasts three days'.
작심삼일.t: Usual pattern: 작심삼일로 끝나다 'to end as a three-day resolution'.

초인종.ex: 누가 초인종을 눌러서 문을 열어 봤어요.
초인종.x: Someone rang the doorbell, so I opened the door.

중매.x: My parents met through a matchmaker and got married.

장인.e: Literally 'elder person'. Homonym warning: another 장인 means 'craftsman'.
장인.t: When talking to or about him politely, say 장인어른.

극찬.ex: 그 소설은 해외 언론에서도 극찬을 받았어요.
극찬.x: That novel was also highly praised by the foreign press.

항암제.x: A lot of hair fell out because of the side effects of the cancer drugs.
항암제.e: Literally 'anti-cancer drug'; 항- = anti-: 항암제, 항생제, 항체.
항암제.t: 항암 치료 is the treatment (chemotherapy); 항암제 is the drug itself.

필연적.x: When competition gets fierce, conflict inevitably arises.
필연적.e: -적 = '-ic, -al', turning nouns into descriptors: 필연적, 경제적.
필연적.t: As a noun it takes 이다: 필연적인 결과, 실패는 필연적이었다.

선심성.ex: 선거 때마다 선심성 공약이 쏟아져 나와요.
선심성.x: Every election, a flood of crowd-pleasing campaign promises comes out.
선심성.e: 선심 'kindness, generosity' + -성: generosity shown to win favor.
선심성.t: Mostly used before nouns and always critical: 선심성 정책, 선심성 예산.

육체.ex: 건강한 육체에 건강한 정신이 깃든다고 해요.
육체.x: They say a healthy mind dwells in a healthy body.
육체.t: 육체 is used when contrasting body and mind; for everyday 'body', say 몸.

정권교체.m: change of government, transfer of power (to another party)
정권교체.x: This election brought a change of government for the first time in ten years.
정권교체.e: Literally 'exchanging political power' — power passes to the other party.
정권교체.t: Pronounced [정꿘교체] — the ㄱ in 권 is tensed.

군사독재.x: Koreans fought against military dictatorship in the 1980s.
군사독재.e: Literally 'military rule by one person deciding alone'.
군사독재.t: Pronounced [군사독째] — the ㅈ after ㄱ is tensed.

착시.ex: 두 선의 길이가 다르게 보이는 건 착시 때문이에요.
착시.x: The two lines look different in length because of an optical illusion.

학술대회.ex: 다음 달 학술대회에서 연구 결과를 발표할 거예요.
학술대회.x: I'm going to present my research results at an academic conference next month.
학술대회.t: 학회 is the shorter, more casual word researchers use for both the society and its conference.

입춘.m: Ipchun, the start of spring (solar term, around Feb 4)
입춘.x: On Ipchun, people write 'Great luck at spring's start' and post it on the gate.

집단주의.ex: 집단주의 문화에서는 개인보다 조직의 이익이 중요합니다.
집단주의.x: In a collectivist culture, the group's interests matter more than the individual's.
집단주의.t: Pronounced [집딴주의] or [집딴주이]; the final 의 is usually said like 이.

따사롭다.x: The spring sunshine is so warm that it's perfect for a walk.
따사롭다.e: A cousin of 따스하다 and 따뜻하다 'warm'.
따사롭다.t: Mostly poetic, and typically paired with 햇살 or 햇볕.

종래.ex: 종래의 방식으로는 이 문제를 해결할 수 없습니다.
종래.x: This problem can't be solved with the conventional method.
종래.e: Literally 'coming from back then (up to now)'.

혹여.x: I left early in case I might be late.
혹여.e: Literally 'perhaps, if'; a more literary 혹시.
혹여.t: Often in 혹여 ~(으)ㄹ까 봐 'in case ~'; 혹여나 adds emphasis.
